tasks.title: Voltage at the board input
tasks.statement: The BEC outputs 5.0 V. The Jetson draws **{i} A** through a pair of wires **{l} m** long with a conductor resistance of **{r} mΩ/m**, and the connector adds 0.05 Ω. Find the voltage at the board input (V).
tasks.solution: R = 2·l·r + R_connector; U = U_BEC − I·R. Compare with the 4.75 V minimum for the Jetson Nano: anything below it is a brownout under load.

tasks.title: The cost of a companion in hover time
tasks.statement: A copter of mass **{m} kg** hovers at a specific power of **{k} W/kg**, and the usable battery energy is **{e} Wh**. A companion is added: mass **{dm} g**, consumption **{pc} W**. By how many minutes does the hover time shrink if hover power grows as m^1.5?
tasks.solution: t₀ = 60·E/(k·m). After installation: P = k·m·((m+Δm)/m)^1.5 + P_c, t₁ = 60·E/P. The answer is t₀ − t₁. Mass usually costs more than watts.

tasks.title: Pipeline frame rate
tasks.statement: The stages run sequentially: capture and preprocessing **{tp} ms**, inference **{ti} ms**, NMS and tracker **{tn} ms** per frame. Find the pipeline frame rate (fps).
tasks.solution: f = 1000 / (t_capture + t_inference + t_post). The inference time from the benchmark table is only part of the frame: with 4.57 ms of inference and 12 ms for everything else you get 60 fps, not 219.
